title: Cricket Re-Entry Block: Movement Quality & Knee-Safe Capacity

athlete_analysis.profile_summary: 21yo recreational top-order batsman, beginner lifter returning to structured training. Lean muscle goal, mild right knee discomfort after long runs, 6.5h sleep, Sunday matches.
primary_constraints: Mild right knee discomfort after long running
Sunday match: no heavy legs Saturday
sport_demands: Front-foot drive needs trunk control and thoracic rotation
Fielding needs deceleration, hip and ankle control
Strike rotation needs quick acceleration and turning
athlete_analysis.block_priority: Re-entry phase: build movement quality, low-impact capacity, scapular and trunk control, and calf/hip durability while monitoring 24h knee response.

weeks.theme: Re-establish patterns, protect knee, build trunk and scapular base
weeks.progression_rule: Progress only if 24h knee response is stable. Keep loads submaximal at RPE 6-7; add no new impact this week.

workouts.title: Lower Strength: Knee-Friendly Squat Pattern
workouts.why_this_session: Teaches a controlled loaded squat and builds calf and hip capacity that protect the knee during fielding and batting movement, without impact.

warmup.name: Lateral Leg Swing
warmup.purpose: Open frontal-plane hip range for fielding lateral movement before loading.

warmup.name: Bird Dog
warmup.purpose: Activate trunk anti-rotation and hip control before squatting.
coaching_notes: Keep ribs down, no low-back sag.

warmup.name: Goblet Squat
warmup.purpose: Rehearse squat depth and knee tracking with light load to prime the pattern.
coaching_notes: Knees track over toes, pain-free range.

main_work.name: Landmine Squat
main_work.purpose: Build a beginner-friendly loaded squat with guided bar path that limits knee shear.
coaching_notes: Stop set if any knee pinch appears.

main_work.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
main_work.purpose: Strengthen glutes and posterior chain to offload the knee and support drive power.

main_work.name: Standing Calf Raise
main_work.purpose: Build calf/soleus tissue capacity to absorb running and fielding load, easing knee stress.
coaching_notes: Use full stretch and full raise.

main_work.name: Pallof Press
main_work.purpose: Train anti-rotation trunk stiffness that transfers to front-foot batting control.

cooldown.name: Lateral Leg Swing
cooldown.purpose: Restore relaxed hip range and downshift after lower-body loading.

cooldown.name: Bird Dog
cooldown.purpose: Reinforce calm trunk control and spine position to end the session.

injury_modifications: Keep squat depth pain-free; reduce range if knee discomfort appears
Avoid any deep loaded knee flexion under fatigue
Stop and regress if knee aches next morning

workouts.title: Upper Push & Scapular Durability
sport_transfer: Shoulder durability for throwing and long fielding
Scapular control for stable bat swing posture
Upper-body lean muscle for power base
workouts.why_this_session: Builds pressing strength and posterior shoulder durability for repeated fielding throws and a stable batting posture, with no knee load.

warmup.name: Band Pull-Apart
warmup.purpose: Wake up posterior shoulder and scapular control before pressing.

warmup.name: Push-Up Plus
warmup.purpose: Activate serratus and scapular protraction for healthy overhead control.

warmup.name: Bird Dog
warmup.purpose: Set trunk stability so pressing stays stable without low-back sag.

main_work.name: Machine Chest Press
main_work.purpose: Build beginner-friendly horizontal push strength with low stability demand.

main_work.name: Machine Shoulder Press
main_work.purpose: Develop overhead pressing capacity for throwing arm strength.

main_work.name: Face Pull
main_work.purpose: Build posterior shoulder and scapular capacity to balance pressing and protect the throwing shoulder.

main_work.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
main_work.purpose: Add lateral deltoid hypertrophy for shoulder balance and lean muscle goal.

cooldown.name: Band Pull-Apart
cooldown.purpose: Flush posterior shoulder and reinforce upright posture after pressing.

cooldown.name: Leaning Bar Hang
cooldown.purpose: Gentle shoulder girdle decompression to end upper-body day.

injury_modifications: Reduce lateral raise load if any shoulder pinch occurs
Keep all pressing pain-free; no knee involvement needed today

workouts.title: Low-Impact Conditioning & Fielding Movement
sport_transfer: Knee-safe aerobic base for long fielding spells
Low-speed ready position and pickup mechanics
Ankle and hip control for safe fielding stops
workouts.why_this_session: Builds low-impact aerobic capacity and rehearses fielding ready position and pickup at low speed, avoiding running impact that triggers knee discomfort.

warmup.name: Lateral Leg Swing
warmup.purpose: Prepare hips for lateral fielding movement and squat-pickup positions.

warmup.name: Band Pull-Apart
warmup.purpose: Prime scapular control for throwing posture in fielding drills.

warmup.name: Bird Dog
warmup.purpose: Set trunk stability for low ready position and safe pickup mechanics.

main_work.name: Stationary Bike Steady Intervals
main_work.purpose: Build aerobic base for long fielding stints with zero running impact to protect the knee.
coaching_notes: Keep cadence smooth, no knee strain.

main_work.name: Fielding Long Barrier Drill (low speed)
main_work.purpose: Rehearse safe ground-fielding body position and soft hands at predictable low speed.
coaching_notes: Trail knee behind hands as barrier.

main_work.name: Two-Hand Rolling Pickup (walk-in)
main_work.purpose: Train approach angle and two-hand pickup without high-speed knee load.
coaching_notes: Soft hands, look ball into hands.

main_work.name: Pallof Press Overhead Reach
main_work.purpose: Build trunk anti-rotation and overhead control transferable to throw-base stability.

cooldown.name: Lateral Leg Swing
cooldown.purpose: Restore relaxed hip range after fielding movement.

cooldown.name: SMR Calf Foam Roll
cooldown.purpose: Reduce calf tension to support knee comfort and recovery.
coaching_notes: Avoid rolling directly on the knee joint.

injury_modifications: Replace all running drills with bike if knee is sensitive
Keep fielding feeds low-speed and predictable; no dives
Stop session if knee swells or aches during

workouts.title: Upper Pull & Trunk Control
sport_transfer: Back strength for throwing and bat control
Lat capacity for stable swing finish
Trunk stiffness for front-foot drive transfer
workouts.why_this_session: Develops pulling strength and trunk control that stabilize the batting swing and support repeated throwing, with no knee-loading demands.

warmup.name: Band Pull-Apart
warmup.purpose: Activate posterior shoulder and scapular retraction before pulling.

warmup.name: Bird Dog
warmup.purpose: Build trunk anti-rotation base before loaded rows.

warmup.name: Lateral Leg Swing
warmup.purpose: Light hip mobility to keep general movement quality before pulling work.

main_work.name: Machine Row
main_work.purpose: Build beginner-friendly horizontal pulling strength with controlled trunk position.

main_work.name: Single-Arm Cable Pulldown
main_work.purpose: Build vertical pull and lat capacity, supporting eventual pull-up progress from 1 rep.

main_work.name: Dumbbell Pullover
main_work.purpose: Train lat and chest through a long arc for swing-finish range and trunk control.

main_work.name: Landmine Rotation
main_work.purpose: Train controlled trunk rotation that transfers to bat swing power.
coaching_notes: Rotate from trunk, not just arms.

cooldown.name: Leaning Bar Hang
cooldown.purpose: Gently decompress shoulders and lats after pulling work.

cooldown.name: Bird Dog
cooldown.purpose: Reinforce calm trunk control to finish the session.

injury_modifications: Skip pullover if overhead shoulder flexion is painful
No knee loading needed; keep all work seated or supported

sport_transfer: Primes hips and trunk for Sunday batting front-foot drive
Activates scapula for fielding throws without fatigue
Light rotation rehearsal for next-day strike rotation

warmup.name: Lateral Leg Swing
warmup.purpose: Open hips for batting stance and fielding stride before tomorrow's match.

warmup.name: Band Pull-Apart
warmup.purpose: Activate posterior shoulder for throwing posture without fatigue.

warmup.name: Bird Dog
warmup.purpose: Prime trunk control for front-foot batting stability tomorrow.

main_work.name: Shadow Batting to Target Line
main_work.purpose: Rehearse front-foot defense and drive line at low effort to prime tomorrow's batting.

main_work.name: Pallof Press
main_work.purpose: Light anti-rotation primer for trunk stiffness used in front-foot drive.

main_work.name: Landmine Rotation (light primer)
main_work.purpose: Gentle rotational rehearsal to prime strike rotation without fatigue.

cooldown.name: Leaning Bar Hang
cooldown.purpose: Light shoulder decompression to feel loose for match day.

cooldown.name: Lateral Leg Swing
cooldown.purpose: Finish with relaxed hip mobility ah
